summary: SharonAI Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into employment agreements with three executives: James Manning (CEO), Tim Broadfoot (CFO), and Andrew Leece (COO), effective May 1, 2026. Terms include base salaries in AUD, short- and long-term incentive awards in cash/RSUs, and one-time listing awards. These are new executive hires, not a forced departure, but the filing is primarily about executive appointments. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisors mentioned. Watch for integration of these officers into the company's strategic direction; no risk-arb angle.
